text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Nineteen of the forty trigger points are flagged for non-blue emulsion, and the event's detections in the 1969 to 1972 window are dominated by the dny, dnr and other non-blue plate tags, so the step may reflect an emulsion response difference rather than a stellar change.","evidence_ids":["E-058","E-045","E-048","E-049","E-051","E-052","E-056"]},{"text":"The non-blue points sit far below the blue-series points: the dny and dnr series zero points are -1.12 and -1.46 magnitudes, against -0.23 for dnb, which suggests a systematic offset between emulsion families that would produce a step when the series changes.","evidence_ids":["E-024","E-025","E-026","E-045","E-048","E-049","E-051","E-052","E-056"]},{"text":"The event epochs run from 1971.00 to 1971.04, and the non-blue detections around that time (E-049 at 1970.997, E-051 at 1971.975) lie on either side of the step, while the blue dnb points before and after it differ only by a few tenths of a magnitude; this pattern fits a seam between plate series.","evidence_ids":["E-002","E-042","E-043","E-044","E-046","E-047","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-054"]},{"text":"One point is flagged for plate-edge effects, and the lightcurve is not detrended (the flag is raised and the curve is the raw one), so an edge or uncorrected plate-level systematic cannot be excluded from the packet.","evidence_ids":["E-063","E-068","E-002"]},{"text":"The packet does not contain the full set of points: block 3 lists 30 of 40 trigger points and the cuts thinned it further, so omitted points could show whether the step persists within a single emulsion family; that check is missing and the artifact case cannot be fully settled from this packet.","evidence_ids":["E-057","E-002"]}]}
